company.name: Fernris Creations
company.shortDescription: Fernris Creations is an independent developer of massively multiplayer games (MMO).
company.description:
Fernris Creations is an independent developer of massively multiplayer online (MMO) games. They are creators of boundless and fascinating universes. Their products feature EVE Online, Project M5, and FPS projects.

Since the launch of EVE Online in May 2003, CCP has established itself as a company in the field, winning numerous awards and receiving critical acclaim worldwide.

productsAndServices.description: A single-shard sandbox massively multiplayer online game set in the New Eden star cluster, where players participate in exploration, commerce, industry, politics, and large-scale space warfare.

productsAndServices.description: A cross-platform game engine framework used to build and operate large-scale persistent online worlds, with systems for graphics, physics, networking, audio, user interfaces, scripting, and resource management.
productsAndServices.name: Carbon

productsAndServices.description: A space survival massively multiplayer online game set in a shattered galaxy, combining resource management, exploration, risk, and player-driven development of the game world.
